expectation: Membrane/cytoplasmic stain on stromal cells: fibroblasts, pericytes and CAFs in a tumor/skin cohort. It should form elongated fibres, septa and vessel-lining networks around tumor nests. Immune and tumor cells should be negative.
observed: A: all ROIs show yellow in branching, fibrous bands and septa, with dark and blue nuclear-rich regions between them. B/C: elongated, spindle-shaped stromal strands run along and around the nuclei-dense (blue) nests, and the nests are mostly negative. D: bright linear membrane-like strands.
why: The stain marks stromal fibre and septal networks that border negative cell nests, as expected for a fibroblast and pericyte marker.
